{"id":1948034857,"question_id":4242,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 1 week","timestamp":1773499850,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"51 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1948034857/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sum of GCD of Formed Pairs","memory":"161.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    \n    long long gcdSum(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<ll>pref(n , 0);\n        int maxi = INT_MIN;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            maxi = max(maxi , nums[i]);\n            pref[i] = gcd(nums[i] , maxi);\n        }\n\n        sort(begin(pref) , end(pref));\n\n        ll ans = 0;\n        int l = 0;\n        int r = n-1;\n\n        while(l < r){\n            ans += gcd(pref[l] , pref[r]);\n            l++;\n            r--;\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sum-of-gcd-of-formed-pairs","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1837}
